description: Full PrivacyPipeline.process runs. input.state.kind: none (no sync, fresh cache), sync (input.state.sync is a /v1/sdk/sync response body fed through the cache merge). A 404 from sync leaves the cache as it was, which for a fresh cache is the none state. input.salt is STUBSMITH_MASK_SALT or null. expected.payload is the exact dict from process() (sdk_version is the SDK constant; duration and source are added later by the client). Body strings are Python json.dumps text. Not covered: the masking-exception degradation path (cannot be triggered from data).
source: stubsmith.privacy.pipeline.PrivacyPipeline.process via a RulesCache whose _http_get is stubbed
